savefile:
Lua
May be used to write arbitrary
files to disk via the engine's
saveFile callback.
deletefile:
Lua
Can be used to permanently
delete files from disk via the
engine's deleteFile callback.
osexecute:
Lua
Exploitable to run arbitrary
shell commands on the host system.
osremove:
Lua
Can be used to delete files
from disk directly,
bypassing engine abstractions.
osrename:
Lua
May be used to rename or
relocate files anywhere on disk.
osexit:
Lua
Can be used to forcefully
terminate the game process.
iopopen:
Lua
Exploitable to spawn external
processes and capture their output.
loadstring:
Lua
Allows execution of arbitrary
Lua code compiled from a
string at runtime.
dofile:
Lua
Can be used to load and execute
arbitrary Lua files at runtime.
loadfile:
Lua
May be used to load arbitrary
Lua files as executable chunks.
windows_gdi_effects:
Windows/GDI
Can start desktop-level GDI
screen distortion effects via
initGDIThread/prepareGDIEffect.
windows_desktop_control:
Windows/GDI
Can hide or move desktop icons,
hide taskbar, or change desktop/taskbar transparency.
windows_wallpaper_control:
Windows/GDI
Can change, save, or restore
the user's Windows wallpaper.
windows_shellwindow_control:
Windows/GDI
Can capture screenshots, show
Windows notifications, or alter
window opacity/borders.
gettextfromfile:
Lua
Can be used to read the contents
of arbitrary files via the
engine callback.
ioopen:
Lua
Exploitable to open any file
on disk for reading or writing.
osgetenv:
Lua
May be used to extract sensitive
environment variables from
the host system.
ostmpname:
Lua
Can be used to generate and
probe temp-file paths on disk.
ossetlocale:
Lua
May be used to alter the
process locale,
affecting system-wide behaviour.
syscommand:
Haxe
Exploitable to execute arbitrary
shell commands on the host system.
sysexit:
Haxe
Can be used to forcefully
terminate the game process.
sysiofile:
Haxe
Allows reading and writing
arbitrary files on disk.
sysioprocess:
Haxe
Exploitable to spawn and interact
with arbitrary external processes.
sysfilesystem:
Haxe
Can be used to list,
inspect, create, or delete files and directories.
cpplibload:
Haxe
Exploitable to load arbitrary
native C++ libraries at runtime.
openfllibapplication:
Haxe
May be used to access and
manipulate the underlying
OpenFL application object.
windowsapi:
Haxe
Direct access to Plus Engine's
Windows native wrapper.
windowscpp:
Haxe
Direct access to low-level
Windows native calls.
windows_gdi_internals:
Haxe
Direct access to the GDI effect
thread or effect registry.
typeresolveclass:
Haxe
Can be used to look up and
obtain references to arbitrary
classes at runtime.
typecreateinstance:
Haxe
May be used to instantiate
arbitrary classes from
runtime references.
reflectcallmethod:
Haxe
Exploitable to invoke arbitrary
methods via reflection,
bypassing normal call paths.
import_sys:
Haxe
Grants access to the top-level
Sys class and its
system-level APIs.
import_cpp:
Haxe
Grants access to the cpp package,
enabling native library interop.
import_windows_native_apis:
Haxe
Grants access to Windows/GDI
helpers that can affect the
user's desktop session.
